output.summary: A deciduous tree native to northern Europe and northern Asia, downy birch has dull grey-white bark and finely hairy shoots. Its inner bark was ground into bread during famines, while spring sap is drunk fresh or made into syrup, ale, wine and liqueurs.
output.edibilityNote: Inner bark was used in traditional and famine breads; spring sap is consumed fresh or made into syrup, ale, wine and liqueurs.
